title: M2 v2 POI Common Definitions
description: Shared definitions for M2 options-first per-day file shape (spec-20260508-221237). Distinct from legacy schemas/poi-common.schema.json which serves the per-agent-envelope shape. M3 will migrate agents to emit v2 directly; until then v1 and v2 coexist.

iso_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 local-or-zoned timestamp; trailing zone optional, seconds optional.

city_context.description: MANDATORY per-option context locked by Q3c (BA ticket-20260514-103616). Identifies which trip-leg this option belongs to, the role the city plays for that leg, and the validity window during which the option is geographically reachable.

city_id.description: Stable identifier (slug) for the city, e.g. 'beijing'.

leg_index.description: Zero-indexed leg within the trip itinerary; consecutive same-city days share the same leg_index.

role.description: Role this city plays for this option's day. origin=depart-from; destination=arrive-into; en_route=pass-through (transit); overnight=sleep-here.

valid_after_ts.description: Earliest local timestamp at which this option becomes reachable on this day (e.g. arrival_ts for a destination role).

valid_before_ts.description: Latest local timestamp at which this option remains reachable on this day (e.g. departure_ts for an origin role).

provenance.description: Per-option selection provenance (§5.2 + §5.7 D + Q3h). Set when an option is selected by user, --auto policy, or auto-lock propagation.

selected_at.description: Timestamp at which selection was recorded.

locked_from_day.description: When selected_by='locked-from-day-N', the source day number; null otherwise.

option_base.description: Common per-option fields used by every slot category (meals, accommodation, attractions, cafe, entertainment, shopping). Slot-specific schemas extend this with category fields via allOf.

option_id.description: Stable per-option identifier within the day; e.g. 'meal-d3-lunch-1'.

name.description: Display name in primary user language.

name_local.description: Name in local script; may be empty.

location_summary.description: Short human-readable address or neighborhood label.

cost.description: Estimated cost in currency_local. null if unknown (renders as 'cost: unknown' per Q3g).

fit_score.description: Agent-computed fit-to-user-requirements score 0..1. Used by --auto policy primary tiebreaker (§5.7 D).

why_fits_user.description: Concise rationale explaining why this option fits the user profile.

source_agent.description: The content agent that produced this option.

source_citation.description: Source links / citations supporting this option.

is_home.description: True if option is a private home (suppresses external image lookup).

slot_envelope.description: Per-slot envelope wrapping options[] with selection state and skip semantics. Used by all 6 named slots and accommodation.

slot_id.description: One of the 7 canonical slot identifiers.

options.description: Candidate options offered by content agents. Floors enforced by validator (meals: >=2/slot; first-night accommodation: >=3).

selected_option_id.description: option_id of chosen option, or null if no selection yet (allowed in draft-options/user-review stages only).

skipped.description: Slot is intentionally absent on this day. Allowed per day_type tolerance (§5.13 B).

skipped_reason.description: Required non-null when skipped=true. Validator rejects skipped slots with skipped_reason=null.

late_arrival_placeholder.description: Dinner-only marker: arrival_ts >= 21:00 local; slot is NOT skipped, but options should be limited to late-night-friendly venues.
